fact: UNDP's terms of reference for tender UNDP-MDG-00611 state that the majority of the Gendarmerie nationale's brigades and research units still use an archaic method in judicial-police work for lack of appropriate means, and that a secure 'Fichier central' recording judicial-police results has been set up at the Direction de la Police Judiciaire, designed and developed by the gendarmerie's own technicians, with limited capacity and no fingerprint handling, which is why UNDP is recruiting a firm to develop and deploy a case-tracking application.
title: UNDP-MDG-00611 CABINET POUR LE DEVELOPPEMENT ET LE DEPLOIEMENT DE LOGICIEL
